content:
leah: Quick sync note  we're locking calibration leads cadence: 2x shorter sessions for small orgs (<10 managers) and 1x longer session for large (>10). This reduces context switching. Thoughts?
omar: sounds good. For large teams can we have a pre-read packet at least 24h in advance? Helps when leads are juggling other work.
trina: Yes please. Pre-read should include: summary offsets, any outlier flags, and anonymized exemplar feedback. Can someone confirm where pre-reads live?
ben: I'll push a 'pre-read' folder to the cycle drive: https://go.redwood/cycle-pre-reads. Please put PDFs only (no PII).
leah: On anonymized exemplar feedback: new rule proposal  redact anything that could identify the reviewer (project names that only one person worked on, names, etc.). Use [REDACTED] tag.
omar: Also suggest a small template for anonymized excerpts so they don't lose meaning. Example: "Contrib: shipped infra refactor; impact: reduced CI time by 30%" instead of naming the project.
trina: Good. Can we add a short eval rubric for calibration leads to grade how useful excerpts are? 3-point scale: 1=not useful, 2=useful, 3=essential. We'll tally to improve examples.
ben: Done. Added 'exemplar_rating' column to the pre-reads index.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Calibration lead roster due 1841228800 (EOD today). Please update the 'cal-leads' tab in the master sheet.
leah: One policy note: after managers submit final scores, minor edits (typos or clarifying comments) are allowed until the 'appeal window' opens. Major score changes require a formal rescind request. We'll publish the rescind form shortly.
omar: What's the length of the appeal window? We need to communicate to ICs.
trina: Proposal: 3 business days after feedback release for appeals. People Ops to run triage and route to the manager + cal lead.
leah: Agreed. We'll also add a short appeals FAQ to the release email.
ben: Ops note: automated export will snapshot scores at release time. Any rescinds will show as an amendment in the audit log.
qa-bot: Checklist run: pre-read folder exists? true. cal-leads tab updated? partial. appeals form published? false.
leah: OK action items: 1) Ben finalize pre-read folder layout; 2) Trina draft anonymization template + exemplar rubric; 3) Omar confirm lead availability; 4) People Ops publish appeals FAQ. Please update the sheet when done.
omar: I'll confirm availability by 11am PT.
trina: I'll drop the anonymization template in the Drive and tag everyone.
people-ops-bot: Note: Cal sessions scheduled starting 1841300000. Auto-reminders set for leads 48h before their session.
leah: Thanks team. We'll announce these changes in the manager playbook and the general cycle update. :sparkles:
